entities.summary: Karabakh Movement and 1988 Earthquake, a transformative movement in Armenia (1988–1991). Emerged from Devastating Spitak earthquake kills approximately 25,000 people and Armenia declares independence from the Soviet Union. Catalyzed Armenian forces capture Shusha/Shushi and the Lachin corridor.
